about_short_description.short_description: Rundoo provides an AI-powered POS and retail management platform for hardware, paint, garden, farm and feed, and lumber stores.

product.name: Web-based Point of Sale
product.description: A cloud-based point of sale system designed for paint and hardware stores to manage sales and billing from any location.

product.name: Detailed Analytics and Reporting
product.description: A real-time analytics and reporting tool that provides insights into pricing, inventory, and store operations for paint and hardware retailers.

product.name: Contractor App
product.description: A mobile application that allows customers to manage jobs, view invoices, and make secure payments related to paint and hardware services.

product.name: Vendor Integrations
product.description: Integration services that connect Rundoo's platform with suppliers and manufacturers to streamline ordering, receiving, and catalog access.

product.name: Customer Support and Training
product.description: Support services including training, troubleshooting, and ongoing assistance for users of Rundoo's software platform.

product.name: Dooey
product.description: An AI assistant embedded in Rundoo's retail software for reporting and operational tasks.
